definition: to return something where it belongs
description: Inside a plain old museum room with tall windows, a young woman in a grey coat, her dark hair in a bun, carefully lowers a heavy carved stone slab into its empty dusty outline on top of a glass display case, while an older man's hands help from the side. She lets go and smooths the dust around it, and the older man in a flat cap leans in to look closely. A crowd of people in winter jackets and caps watches. Other stone fragments stand inside the case, with work gloves on top and a bucket nearby.

taps.target: the man in the flat cap
